title: Expose both stale annotation pins
preconditions: A separate fresh Saga has an external prototype r1 and annotation pinned to r1 and story s1.

steps.action: Append prototype r2 and compose against story s2 without editing the annotation.
steps.expected_result: The annotation is not current and reports both prototype and story revision changes.

steps.action: Read the annotation after both endpoints advance.
steps.expected_result: Its stored prototype/story pins remain r1 and s1 rather than retargeting.
